comments.body:
Because the proficiency gain follows a formula (shown above the proficiency/level chart) into which you can substitute in any rank, including R1.

If you can't find it:

(Adventure Lv + Trade Lv + Battle Lv + Req. Building Days) * 8.5 / (Rank +1)
